ns2:course.label: Advanced Anatomy for Teaching
ns2:course.description: Advanced Anatomy for Teaching is an elective course designed to enhance regional anatomy knowledge and teaching skills. Through one-on-one and small group lab instruction, students will learn best practices in anatomy education, reflect on their teaching principles, and create educational resources. Students will create either an educational resource to be used for teaching anatomy or an in-depth literature review of medical education pedagogy. No graduate credit. 4 professional hours. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Restricted to students enrolled beyond Phase 1 of the Carle Illinois College of Medicine.
